question.en: Draw an activity diagram that describes the functionalities associated with members of a library. Members can come to the library and search the books using the terminals in the library. Searching is done by entering keywords (title and the name of the author). Once the search has been performed, a list of the results is shown. If any book from the list is of interest to the member, he/she can mark it and put it in a wish list. This list can be printed by the member as needed. When the entire search process is completed, members can go to the rental desk and ask for borrowing a book from the wish list. The borrowing can be made only if the member is registered in the library and if he/she has no more than five borrowings. If the member is not registered, he/she applies for registration, and after that the member can borrow the books.

After the search, users get a list of plays and by selecting one of them, the system displays detailed information about it. On this screen, there is a booking button. question.en: Describe the activities related to the waiter and the chef in a restaurant. The restaurant has a computer system through which communication will be performed between its employees. When the waiter logs on to the system, he waits for one of the restaurant guests to order something from the menu with specialties. When guests order something, the waiter sends a message through his computer to the chef about the specialty to be prepared. Once the specialty is ready, the chef again informs the waiter through the system, that the order is ready, and that the guests can be served. After serving, the procedure for additional orders can be repeated several times. When guests have finished eating, they can ask the waiter for a bill. He prints the bill, and charges it. If necessary, he can return a change. The chef, when preparing for a particular specialty, should update the data for the products that are available in the warehouse.

question.en: A system for displaying and scheduling events (meetings) in a company should be modeled. To use the system, employees of the company should log in with their usernames and passwords. After logging in, on the HOME PAGE the user has a choice to see the new events he has been invited to (and still has not accepted), or to look at the calendar of events he has accepted. By clicking on the NEW EVENTS button, the user gets a list of all new events to which he is invited. By selecting an event from the list, detailed information about the event is displayed as well as buttons for accepting and rejecting the event. If the event is accepted it is added to the calendar. If not, the data for the selected event is updated. After the response, the user returns to the home page. By clicking on the CALENDAR button on the home page, the user can choose a calendar view (weekly, monthly or daily). If he chooses a daily view, a list of events scheduled on the selected day is displayed. Clicking on the event name displays the details of that event. If a weekly view is selected, the days of the week are displayed and each event is displayed with a brief description. The user can click on the name of a day and a complete daily view of that day is displayed. From the daily view or directly from a weekly view, the user can select an event for detailed information. Draw an activity diagram.
